name: Subspace Clustering for Multivariate Volume Visualization
definition: A visualization pipeline that uses subspace clustering to identify low-dimensional linear subspaces within high-dimensional multivariate volumetric data, enabling effective Transfer Function (TF) design through animated transitions (dynamic projections) between 2D views of these subspaces.
summary: Subspace Clustering for Multivariate Volume Visualization is a pipeline that uses data-driven subspace clustering to define meaningful animated transitions between 2D views, mitigating structural illusions inherent in static high-dimensional projections.
